headline: Oil Prices Slip Near Four-Week Lows on Peace Talks and Supply Shifts
summary: Brent and WTI crude oil futures declined, trading near four-week lows following peace negotiations involving Ukraine and Iran, after initially opening higher.
why: Geopolitical developments concerning major oil-producing regions or conflict resolutions directly influence global crude oil benchmarks and energy sector equities.
